words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not begin a new, free-standing group. It reaches back across the ayah boundary to the deniers named in 83:10, and its masculine plural form keeps that antecedent in view before the verb appears. As a relative pronoun, it also withholds the group's full description until {{ar:يُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibūna}}) and its complement arrive, so the ayah defines the warned class by the act and object of denial. The matching plural cadence between {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) and {{ar:يُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibūna}}) makes that syntactic bond audible as well as grammatical.

words.prose: {{ar:يُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibūna}}) makes the prior label active. Its Form II shape selects outward falsification: the people are not merely uncertain, and the verse is not simply saying that they lie; it portrays them as repeatedly treating the Day as false. The doubled middle radical is heard inside that Form II pressure before the denied horizon is named. The imperfect keeps that act ongoing inside the relative definition, while the plural ending carries the subject from {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) without repeating a noun. The verb also does not float without an object: it takes {{ar:بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:bi-yawmi al-dīn}}) as a bāʾ-marked complement, so the continuing falsification is aimed at an appointed accountability horizon. Same-surah repetition of the {{ar:ك ذ ب}} ({{tr:k-dh-b}}) root in 83:10, 83:12, and 83:17 makes this verb the hinge between a named class and the later moral narrowing of the denier, while the denial formula in 95:7 shows that the local posture belongs to a wider Quranic refusal-formula.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is the small hinge that prevents the verb from remaining a general description of denial. It attaches {{ar:يُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibūna}}) to {{ar:يَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yawmi}}), and because that noun heads the construct {{ar:يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:yawmi al-dīn}}), the particle scopes over the whole title. Its force is both object-like and domain-like: they deny the Day, and they deny with respect to the whole accountability horizon that the Day names. The fused form {{ar:بِيَوْمِ}} ({{tr:bi-yawmi}}) makes that dependency visible and audible, while the shift from the prior warning particle in 83:10 to this bāʾ complement shows why the class receives woe: the rejected object is now named.

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yawmi}}) is pulled in two directions at once. Backward, it is genitive under {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), so the day becomes the governed matter denied by {{ar:يُكَذِّبُونَ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibūna}}). Forward, it heads the construct with {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}), so it remains incomplete until accountability defines what kind of day it is. The root can name ordinary day-span or broader time, but this singular construct narrows the word to one specified event-time: an encounter that arrives, not a loose doctrine. In recitation, {{ar:يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:yawmi al-dīn}}) links as one phrase, so the dependency between the time-word and its defining noun is audible as well as syntactic. The same-surah movement from {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}) in 83:10 to {{ar:يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:yawmi al-dīn}}) in 83:11 turns a deictic pointer into the named Day, and the cross-surah formula known from 1:4 and 82:17-18 is here placed under falsification.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}) is the word that lets the construct phrase land. Grammatically it is governed by {{ar:يَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yawmi}}), not separately by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), yet semantically it defines the whole day: the denied time is the recognized Day of accounting. Its definiteness keeps the phrase from meaning one possible day of judgment-like significance. The {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) field is broader than courtroom judgment alone, joining judgment, recompense, debt-like liability, obedience, and binding order; in this formula those pressures converge as final answerability and settlement. Because the word is the abstract noun {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}), it names the governing order of liability rather than a single concrete debt or the act of contracting one. The alternate lowness or submission pressure is useful only as background intensification, because the local formula selects {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) accountability rather than replacing it with another root. As the final word, {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}) closes the ayah on the very order the deniers falsify; the linked phrase is heard with the doubled dāl of {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīn}}), and echoes with 1:4 and 82:17-19 sharpen the contrast between a recognized, magnified Day and the posture that treats it as false.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Denial of the day when deeds return as account.** `ك ذ ب` B002 supplies denial; `ي و م` B003 supplies a major event-day; `د ي ن` B002 supplies reckoning and recompense. The record in 83:7–9 precedes this definition, and the final `ثُوِّبَ` in 83:36 supplies recompense returning to the doer. I assign the day the role of converting stored marks into requital. The abductive arrow is that an exact record enables exact return. The ayah reads as denial of a complete accounting mechanism, not merely denial of a date.

2. **Denial of accountability is also refusal of submission.** `د ي ن` B001 supplies obedience, submission, and a followed law. The offenders insist on full rights from people but reject the authority above them. I infer that denying reckoning functions socially as refusal to be under the same norm one imposes on others. The ayah preserves a political-ethical reading beside the eschatological one.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The closing `ثُوِّبَ` in 83:36 unexpectedly supplied the return-direction inside `د ي ن` B002: reckoning is not only a verdict but deeds coming back as recompense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Denial aimed at reckoning, not at time.** Lexical evidence: ك ذ ب/B002 in يُكَذِّبُونَ; ي و م/B003, "an event-day or severe occasion," in يَوْمِ; and د ي ن/B002, "reckoning and recompense," in ٱلدِّينِ. Structural cue: 83:6-9 unfolds collective standing and a marked record; 83:15-16 unfolds exclusion and fire. Assigned role: the day contains the process, while د ي ن/B002 names its accounting operation. Abductive move: I infer that the active denial targets the accountability architecture rather than calendar futurity. Reading change: the object phrase means repudiating a day that settles accounts, not merely disbelieving that a future date exists.

2. **A liability reaching maturity.** Lexical evidence: د ي ن/B003, "debt and credit," secondarily activated in ٱلدِّينِ. Structural cue: the window places a written record (83:7-9) before the repeated predicate of what they have been acquiring (83:14; ك س ب/B001), followed by blocked access and fire (83:15-16). Assigned role: debt turns acquired acts into deferred liabilities; the day is their maturity point. Abductive move: I infer a moral credit system from record, acquisition, and recompense; the packet does not call the acts loans. Reading change: denial becomes an attempt to erase deferred obligation while continuing to accumulate it.

3. **Submission displaced by self-authored valuation.** Lexical evidence: د ي ن/B001, "obedience and submission," in ٱلدِّينِ. Structural cue: 83:6 places all people before the Lord, whereas 83:12-13 shows the transgressor issuing his own verdict on recited signs. Assigned role: B001 frames the day as the terminal disclosure of which authority governs judgment. Abductive move: I infer that declaring the signs "tales" is an act of substituting one's own jurisdiction. Reading change: denying the day is already a present refusal of submission, enacted each time the speaker claims final authority over a sign.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Earnings at 83:14 followed by exclusion and fire at 83:15-16 made د ي ن/B003 "debt and credit" unexpectedly coherent: acts are acquired now and mature as liabilities later. The sequence also corrected "day" from an abstract date to the settlement event of د ي ن/B002.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same cycle extends backward to delay before good and forward to confession, renunciation, and expiation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Truth Enacted as Recognized Good

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Truth is not only a proposition here but conduct that proceeds into action. Its social face is the good that sound judgment recognizes, while its relational form is willing obedience.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçeğe aykırı söz ve davranışı kapsar; başkasını yalancılıkla niteleme eylemini ya da özel kalıpların bağımsız anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi betimleyen türevler ile özürlere ilişkin kalıp yalnız kendi sözcüksel karşılıklarında gösterilir ve yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün veya davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasıdır. Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, yalan söyleyen ya da yalanı çokça tekrarlayan biri olarak betimlenebilir.

facets.statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
Bu niteliği taşıyan veya onu sıkça gösteren kişi, yalan söyleyen kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğa aykırılığı ortak çekirdek sayar; kullanım alanını söz ve davranış olarak verir ve bu niteliği taşıyan kişiye yönelik adlandırmaları aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem söz hem davranış alanındaki bütün yalın anlam çekirdeğini karşılayan açıklayıcı üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğa karşıtlığı ve bunun söz ile davranıştaki kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın söz veya davranıştaki doğruluğa aykırılığı zaten belirginleştirdiği doğal kullanımlarda uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir işlemi değil, birbirine bağlı iki işlemi içerir: bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla nitelemek ve bazı türemiş biçimlerde kişiyi yalancı bulmak ya da yalanını açığa çıkarmak. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu ayrım tek bir genel 'yalan yükleme' anlatımı içinde eritilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalan üretmeyi değil, kişi veya söz hakkında yalan hükmü vermeyi ve belirli türevlerde bu hükmü bulguya dayandırmayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, türemiş ve nesne alan biçimlerinin farklı işlemlerini ayırır; bunlardan hiçbiri yalın biçimin genel yalan anlamı olarak sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla ilişkilendirerek yalan olduğunu söylemektir. Bazı türemiş biçimlerde işlem, kişiyi yalancı bulma ya da yalanını ortaya çıkarma sonucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya söz, yalan olduğu söylenerek doğruluk bakımından olumsuz değerlendirilir.
Belirli türemiş biçimler, kişiyi yalancı bulmayı veya onun yalanını ortaya çıkarmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini ya da bir sözü yalanla niteleme konusunda birleşir; aynı toplu kanıt, ayrı bir türemiş biçimde kişiyi yalancı bulma veya yalanı açığa çıkarma yorumunu da taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir kalıbı zorunluluk bildirme ve bir işi yapmaya yöneltme anlamlarıyla açıklar. Bu anlamın yalan söylemeyle doğrudan bir bileşeni yoktur ve yalnız söz konusu kalıp içinde geçerlidir.
